project.name: BVC Task Management — A Simple Daily Work Manager
project.environment: Existing Google AI Studio Build mode project

task.title: PHASE B2 — SAVE YOUR TASK
task.objective: Extend the accepted B1 in-memory task capture flow with a small versioned browser-local workspace using localStorage, load the saved task list on the next page load, and disclose the Beginner storage behavior under approved DR-005 before any task is persisted.
task.risk_note: A bounded single-component change introducing browser-local persistence and user-facing data transparency. The implementation is reversible and uses only synthetic learning data, but storage failure and preservation controls are mandatory.

approved_decisions: DR-014 ACCEPTED FOR DESIGN; runtime verification required
authority.prior_contract: BVC-TM-TC-004 Revision 1 APPROVED — B1 accepted by Human Owner 2026-11-12 with known limitations
authority.approval_status: PROPOSED — requires explicit Human Owner approval before execution

learning_outcome: Understand the difference between in-memory React state and browser-local persistence.
Save a task workspace to the current browser profile without a database or sign-in.
Understand the exact Beginner storage disclosure before relying on persistence.
Observe honest save/load feedback and storage errors.
intent.expected_outcome: A task created in the existing B1 UI is written to a versioned workspace in localStorage; after a normal reload in the same browser profile and app origin, the task is loaded back and displayed once in the existing list.
intent.non_goal: This lesson does not implement the complete product data model, a general storage framework, backup/import/export, cloud sync, Projects, Checklists, Starter Kits, task editing/deletion/completion, settings navigation, or advanced architecture.

recovery_point.source_of_truth: Existing GAIS project identified by app id ca589018-617d-4919-bbe2-6b9c588ccd85
recovery_point.pre_edit_required: Re-open Code view and inspect current app/page.tsx immediately before editing; compare with the Owner-provided B1 source and report differences.

user_supplied_b1_source.structure: One Page component with Task { id, title }, title/tasks/errorMessage React state, semantic form, Add task submit handler, task list and empty state.
user_supplied_b1_source.note: The actual GAIS export/source for B1 has not yet been provided as a verifiable repository artifact. Do not fabricate a Git source commit or hash.

storage.scope_note: This B2 lesson follows the canonical Phase 3.2 Data Model envelope. The B2 vertical slice reads and writes only data.tasks and preserves all other envelope collections as empty collections/empty settings. Projects, checklists, Starter Kits, workspace preferences, timezone semantics and richer entities are deferred to later Contracts. The timezone field from the design example is intentionally not included in this B2 envelope because it is not required by the task-only Beginner vertical slice.
storage.id_generation: Use crypto.randomUUID() if available in the actual GAIS Preview. If not available, inspect existing scaffold/browser support and propose a safe UUID strategy; stop if implementation would require a package or unsupported assumption.
validation: Parse JSON without coercing malformed values.
Require data.tasks to be an array.
Require each task to have a unique non-empty id and a non-empty trimmed title.
Preserve known empty collections projects, checklistItems, settings and appliedStarterKits without adding UI for them.
For a malformed or unsupported existing value, do not overwrite or clear it; display a recoverable storage error and preserve the raw value.
storage.initialization: If localStorage key is absent, treat it as a new empty workspace in memory. The first valid task submission may create the versioned persisted workspace after DR-005 acknowledgement.
storage.write_order: Construct the complete next envelope in memory -> serialize -> call localStorage.setItem once for the single agreed key -> only after success commit the new React tasks state and clear the input/validation messages. If setItem throws, retain the prior React task list and title input, display a truthful error and do not claim the task was saved.
storage.load_order: On first client mount, read the localStorage key once and validate the canonical format identifier, formatVersion 1, workspaceId and data.tasks records. Do not write an initial empty state before load completes. If the key is absent, use an in-memory empty task list as an unsaved new workspace; DR-005 notice must be acknowledged before the first persisted task.
storage.atomicity_note: localStorage.setItem is atomic for a single key from the application's perspective; use one versioned workspace key and never split a task across multiple keys.
storage.quota_and_access_errors: Catch storage exceptions (including quota/security/unavailable storage errors), show a plain-language message, preserve the current data and entered title, and allow the user to retry. Do not silently fall back to sessionStorage or memory while displaying a saved-success state.
storage.cross_tab: Cross-tab synchronization is out of scope. No BroadcastChannel or storage-event synchronization is required.

acknowledgement.display_before_persisted_task: Show exact approved disclosure inline at top of workspace, before task entry is enabled for the first persisted task.
acknowledgement.copy: Where your tasks are stored — In Beginner mode, your tasks are stored in this browser on this device. They do not automatically sync to other browsers or devices. Clearing this site's browser data may delete your tasks. Browser storage is not a separate backup. You will learn to export a JSON backup in a later lesson. Do not enter passwords, API keys, or sensitive information in this learning app.
acknowledgement.remember_state: Proposed Contract rule: keep acknowledgement in component memory only for the current page session. On a fresh page load, show DR-005 before enabling creation of the first persisted task. Once an existing valid saved workspace is loaded, storage disclosure remains accessible through an inline 'Where your tasks are stored' information control in this same page; it does not block adding tasks again. Do not persist acknowledgement separately in localStorage/cookies/sessionStorage in this revision.
acknowledgement.critical_open_point: The proposed session-only rule above is part of this Contract proposal and requires explicit Human Owner approval. Do not implement until approved.

storage.workspace_id_creation: Generate one workspaceId when a new, previously unsaved workspace is first persisted; retain that id on subsequent writes. Never generate a new workspaceId on every task add or page refresh.

behavior: Preserve the B1 title-only input, Add task, trimmed titles, exact empty input validation, task insertion order, empty state, semantic label and Enter submission.
On initial load, display any valid tasks stored under the workspace key.
Before the first valid task is persisted in a new workspace/session, display the DR-005 inline disclosure; the Add task interaction must not persist a task before acknowledgement.
When the learner acknowledges, enable task entry; acknowledgment alone must not write a workspace or claim a backup exists.
When a valid task is submitted, attempt to persist the next workspace. Show it as saved only after localStorage.setItem succeeds.
When a stored workspace exists, subsequent tasks update the same versioned workspace and maintain insertion order.
On refresh, previously saved tasks are reloaded from the same app origin and browser profile.
No automatic cross-device sync is provided.
No export/import, restore, cloud backup or account sign-in is included.
ux_constraints: Preserve current B1 UI layout and component structure as much as practical.
Use the Phase 3.1 design package as the design authority; do not redesign the app.
DR-005 appears as a concise inline notice at the top of the current workspace, not a blocking modal or full-screen onboarding flow.
Use current typography, spacing, surfaces, border and responsive behavior already present. Do not invent new global color tokens.
At phone width, the notice must wrap naturally without horizontal scrolling and the task input/Add task remain usable.
Provide accessible heading, text, action, focus state and clear success/error status.
Do not claim settings navigation exists; More -> Settings & Backup remains a future full-product location until implemented.
out_of_scope: Projects, checklists, notes, priority, due dates, status, task edit/delete/complete.
Supabase, PostgreSQL, Auth, RLS, Firebase, Gemini API, GitHub integration, remote sync, cloud storage.
Backup download/import/restore UI and DR-006 conflict semantics.
More navigation and Settings & Backup screen.
Any new package, lockfile, configuration, global CSS, layout, route, image asset or documentation file inside GAIS.

acceptance_criteria.statement: On a fresh page session, before the first task to be persisted, the exact DR-005 Beginner disclosure is shown at the top of the workspace and the learner must select Got it — continue before persistence is enabled. After a valid workspace is loaded on a later refresh, the disclosure remains accessible without repeatedly blocking normal task entry.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Use a fresh browser profile for first-use test; acknowledge; add a task; reload and verify tasks load and disclosure remains accessible. Attempting to submit before acknowledgement must not write data.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The disclosure explains browser/device scope, no automatic sync, possible loss when site data is cleared, no backup by itself, later JSON export and no sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Compare rendered copy word-for-word with the approved DR-005 English text.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A valid task added after acknowledgement is persisted to the agreed single versioned localStorage key.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Add a sample task and inspect browser storage through available Preview/browser tools; if internal storage inspection is unavailable, retain code-level inspection and reload evidence and mark direct key inspection NOT_VERIFIED.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A previously persisted valid workspace is loaded on normal page refresh in the same app origin and browser profile.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Add two distinct tasks, refresh Preview, and confirm both appear once in the original order.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The B1 title trim, empty/space-only validation, Enter submission, clear-input, clear-error, insertion-order and empty-state behaviors remain correct.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run the B1 regression checklist after B2 implementation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A malformed or unsupported stored workspace is not silently overwritten or cleared.
acceptance_criteria.verification: With Owner supervision, test malformed JSON and an unsupported version in a disposable browser profile; verify an explicit recovery/error state and no automatic destructive reset.

acceptance_criteria.statement: If localStorage read/write throws, the app reports the failure honestly, preserves the current input/list and never shows a false saved-success state.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Use an available controlled storage-failure simulation if GAIS supports it; otherwise perform static exception-path review and record runtime injection as NOT_RUN.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Exactly app/page.tsx changes; no other GAIS file, dependency, lockfile, route, configuration, global style or external service changes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Review GAIS Code/File Explorer before/after changed-file inventory.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The app remains usable at phone and desktop widths with no horizontal overflow caused by the disclosure.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect GAIS Preview at representative compact and desktop widths; capture authentic screenshots.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Human Owner reviews the actual GAIS Preview, code diff and evidence and explicitly accepts B2.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Owner confirmation; AI completion text alone is insufficient.

A new dependency, configuration, layout, CSS or route is required.
localStorage is unavailable or a safe failure path cannot be implemented in the allowed file.

A workspace migration beyond formatVersion 1 is needed.
Malformed existing data might be overwritten or lost.
An unresolved UX/Product decision affects implementation.
